constraints: Preserve original seeds, warmup, correctness, scheduler, shots per call, postselection and aggregate output.
Report any selected batch other than 1; never silently force it.

Loss disappears or reverses: process/placement sensitivity weakens consistent-regression evidence without proving absence.
Mixed findings: present uncertainty for release-risk decision.
